_about: The fit score's settings (FIT_SETTINGS, default apply/fit-settings.json); a key left out keeps its default. weights: a requirement's weight by its place in the posting (title: the skill in the job title; must_years: a must-have that asks years; must: another must-have; nice: a nice-to-have). grades: the lowest score of each band (under long_shot: weak). channel_notes: a note per place, added to the fit's reason line; it never changes the grade. work_languages: the main programming languages (and platforms, such as Android) the person has used at work; a role whose title or must-haves ask only others is a skip, a platform counting in the title only (choices.py fit --set work_languages=Java). languages and platforms: the lists those names come from, name: [pattern, flags]; the plugin's own when left out. Made-up example.

channel_notes.Springfield: board applications here get few replies; a referral or a recruiter works better
